title: PORTAL: label-efficient per-batch selection of a test-time intervention
setting: A logistic regression is trained on a clean 10-d two-class Gaussian source, then deployed on a stream of 24 batches of 64 points under a feature-wise scale/offset shift. Three fixed candidates (source, batch-statistics normalization, and their mean-logit ensemble) have predictions fixed per batch. A controller spends a small label budget on a 32-point query pool of each batch to pick one candidate, which is scored on the other 32 held-out points. Batches arrive either class-mixed or in class-dominated (90/10) blocks, where batch-stat normalization tends to fail.

paper.title: When Should We Intervene at Test Time?
paper.claim: A controller that evaluates all candidates on each shared label, aims queries at rivals that can still overtake the leader and stops early (PORTAL) deploys better predictions than uniform-query ERM selection and avoids the failures of always applying an intervention.

metric.name: deployed_acc
metric.description: Mean accuracy on the unlabeled deployment half of each batch using the candidate the controller chose, averaged over the stream. Diagnostics: oracle_gap (per-batch oracle minus deployed accuracy), labels_used (mean labels per batch), frac_bn (fraction of batches deploying batch-norm), p10_batch_acc (10th percentile batch accuracy).

factors.name: method
factors.description: uniform_erm: uniformly sampled labels, deploy the candidate with the fewest queried errors. portal: shared-label Dirichlet posterior over prediction-pattern strata, value-of-information query targeting, reachability and EVPI-bound stopping. always_bn: always deploy batch-stat normalization with no labels.

factors.name: arrival
factors.description: mixed: each batch is class-balanced in expectation. class_block: batches arrive in blocks of 4 with a 90% dominant class that alternates between blocks.

factors.name: shift
factors.description: Strength of the feature-wise scale and offset corruption applied to the stream. Mild shift leaves the source model decent; strong shift usually makes it poor.

factors.name: budget
factors.description: Maximum number of labels the controller may query per batch.
